title: Reader with independent passage encoding
input: Return no more than one paper introducing a generative reader that encodes retrieved passages separately and fuses them in its decoder. The retriever is not jointly learned in this work. Exclude standalone retrieval, reflection-token control, and retrieval benchmarks.
constraints: 只根据本题授权论文原文判断本篇贡献，缺失证据不凭背景提及补全。
expected_output: 相关论文完整文件名和有原文依据的理由；无匹配可为空。
